thread:
caroline-support: Hey team — customer ACME Corp reported their invoice for Mar shows 120,321,450 tokens billed but our project usage CSV/dashboard reports 98,765,432 tokens. They're being charged >20% more. Can someone take a look? billing_period: 2026-03-01..2026-03-31. sample request_id: req_9f3a

billing-bot: Automatic note — this account hit a temporary quota fallback on 2026-03-12 03:22 UTC, there was a fallback to a different model causing different pricing buckets. See https://billing.redwood.example/alerts/123 :information_source:

maria-support: @caroline-support can you paste the invoice number and workspace/org id? Also which project they think is underreported?

caroline-support: invoice INV-8675309, org_id: org_42, projects: proj_acme_prod, proj_acme_staging. Customer says prod shows ~99M in dashboard; invoice includes ~21M extra tokens.

ash-devex: did they switch from streaming->nonstreaming or enable embeddings? streaming chunking sometimes inflates token counts in our billing pipeline vs realtime metrics. Also check if they used "max_tokens" overrides on a few long calls.

tom-sre: Repro tip: run query against raw request logs for org_42 for Mar 1-31. Example query:
``
SELECT count_tokens(request) as tokens, model, request_id
FROM raw_requests
WHERE org_id='org_42' AND time >= '2026-03-01' AND time < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY model
``
I saw a past issue where batched internal retries were counted twice in invoice ETL.

alex-ml: Also check the ETL job that aggregates windowed quotas — we had a bug where ephemeral system calls (kv-cache prewarm) were attributed to the wrong project after a failover. I'll grep for request ids around 2026-03-12.

caroline-support: Pasting sample log from customer (redacted):
```
{ "time": "2026-03-12T03:22:10Z", "request_id": "req_9f3a", "project_id": "proj_acme_prod", "model": "gpt-neox-20b", "tokens_in": 512, "tokens_out": 10240, "streaming": true }
```
Customer claims tokens_out similar in dash but invoice shows bigger. 

maria-support: @jen-billing can you confirm if invoice pipeline includes org-level rollups and hidden system tokens? Also are we applying any post-processing multipliers for certain models?

jen-billing: I'll pull the billing slab for INV-8675309. Early note: invoice pipeline uses the ETL aggregations from the billing cluster (job billing_agg_v2); it includes a "system_tokens" bucket for index maintenance and a "retry" deduction step that should subtract duplicates — but that step failed on 2026-03-12 for a subset of orgs. Escalating to eng-billing.

ash-devex: Actionable repro for eng-billing: run billing_agg_v2 with --org org_42 --period 2026-03 and compare intermediate tables billing_raw, billing_dedupe, billing_rollup. If entries in billing_raw > billing_dedupe by ~21M tokens, dedupe step failed.

tom-sre: I'm attaching a quick command to fetch counts from S3 (if anyone needs it):
```
aws s3 cp s3://billing-raw/2026-03/org_42/billing_raw.parquet - | parquet-tools rowcount -
```

maria-support: Customer is urgent, CC'ing them on updates. @caroline-support can you request their CSV export of realtime usage and the exact time window they used to compare? We need both sides.

caroline-support: Done, customer sent CSV (received). I'll upload to secure share and post link in thread when available.

jen-billing: For transparency, I'm creating internal ticket BILL-2247 and assigning to eng-billing. ETA first triage in 4 hours.

alex-ml: If billing dedupe job is the culprit, fix is likely a 1-line patch and re-run, but we need to ensure reprocessing doesn't double-bill other customers. We'll run a dry-run re-agg and validate diffs.

maria-support: Thanks all. Next steps: eng-billing triage -> run billing_agg_v2 dry-run -> produce diff report -> if confirmed, schedule reprocess and issue credit if overbilled. I'll update customer after triage. :+1:

caroline-support: thx, I'll keep customer updated and paste link to CSV here.

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-2247 created by jen-billing. Priority: P1. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/BILL-2247

tom-sre: Note: capture request_ids for any retry loops around 03:22 UTC on Mar 12. They will help prove duplicate counts.

maria-support: Thread summary for the record: reported invoice vs usage delta ~21M tokens for org_42 in Mar 2026. Suspect failed dedupe in billing pipeline on 2026-03-12. Eng-billing assigned. Customer provided CSV. Followups in BILL-2247.

caroline-support: closing the loop for now, will ping here after eng update.
